target_customer: Card issuers and fintech card programs needing physical debit and credit cards
problem: Issuers need custom-designed physical cards manufactured and shipped while keeping their existing issuing stack.
product_category: Physical card design, manufacturing and fulfillment

founders.name: Khurram Aslam
founders.background_notes: A third-party profile suggests earlier roles at Stripe, Goldman Sachs and Barclays but it was not a company or press source, so not recorded.

technical_complexity.rationale: Mostly operations and supplier coordination for card production with API integrations to issuer platforms; limited evidence of deep technology.

defensibility.rationale: Card manufacturing is a commodity service with large incumbents such as CPI Card Group; no moat evidence found.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No move against Laminate found; incumbents already offer instant issuance and fintech card services per their own materials.

market_need_then: Fintechs with online-only products treat the physical card as their main offline touchpoint per a CPI 2023 guide; no Laminate specific demand evidence.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic word that returns laminated business card results in search; no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Laminate is a single-founder YC W23 company that still lists as active, with a one page website offering card design, manufacturing and fulfillment. No funding, customers, press or team information was found, so its trajectory is unknown rather than failed. The generic name and commodity incumbents are risks but the sources do not show an outcome.
notes: No funding, customer or press evidence found in searches. Competitor list empty: CPI Card Group was found only through 2023 to 2025 vendor content and is not a dated direct comparison. Founder background unsourced beyond an unverified profile, so left null.
